characteristics.$text: After this unit has charged select 1 enemy unit withing engagment range of this unit. Roll a dice for each [NAME] in this unit. On each 4+ the selected unit suffers 1 mortal wound

sharedRules.name: Overcharge
sharedRules.description: When a unit makes a **[Hazardous]** roll for a weapon with this ability -1 to the roll.

sharedRules.name: Pinning

A unit hit by a weapon with this ability is pinned.
A pinned unit has -2" to advance,movment and charge

sharedRules.name: A talent for Murder
sharedRules.description: When making an attack in the **fight** or **shooting** phase if the target is battle-shocked or this unit outnumbers them add 1 to the wound roll. **Terminators** and **Jump Pack** units count as 1 more to determine if a unit is outnumbered. **Vehicles** count as their maximum wounds

rules.name: The flag of the Legion
rules.description: While this model is **attached** a unit, add 1 to the **Objective Control** characteristic of models in that unit.
